description: This file defines the Location class within the Opencart admin model for localisation, providing CRUD operations and retrieval methods for location records in the database.
external_files: opencart ase ramework	he database class or connection handling

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Model class for managing location data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving locations in the database.

methods.name: addLocation
methods.description: Creates a new location record in the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: editLocation
methods.description: Updates an existing location record identified by location_id.

methods.name: deleteLocation
methods.description: Deletes a location record from the database.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Fetches a specific location record by its ID.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of location records, with optional filters for sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLocations
methods.description: Returns the total number of location records in the database.
